name: Open a program and complete a lesson
description: Verifies the main learning workflow opens a program lesson and records completion.
steps: From Learning Home, open NAMI Connection Recovery Support Group
Use the lesson completion control to mark the lesson learned
expected: The lesson shows as completed and the Learning Studio remains navigable.

name: Use the mobile navigation and Matrix audio controls
description: Verifies the iPhone-sized layout can navigate to Themes, activate Matrix, and expose its audio controls without requiring external playback.
steps: Go to Themes and choose Matrix Terminal
Stay on Themes and inspect the Matrix audio settings section
Toggle Matrix sound effects off and on
Return to Learning Home and confirm no Matrix audio panel floats over the page
expected: The mobile menu is usable, Matrix becomes the active theme, soundtrack and SFX controls are available inline on Themes, and no floating Matrix audio panel appears on Learning Home.

name: Search for a known learning topic
description: Verifies the Studio can search its learning content and open a matching result.
steps: Use Search the studio to search for privacy
Open one of the returned learning results
expected: At least one relevant result is shown and the selected result opens inside the Learning Studio.

name: Handle a search with no matches
description: Verifies a nonsense search fails gracefully instead of leaving a blank or broken screen.
expected: The page reports 0 results and shows the No matching topics yet guidance with a suggestion to try a shorter word or program name.

name: Use the Star Wars theme and audio controls
description: Verifies the Star Wars theme keeps decorative lettering focused on display text while its soundtrack, sound-effects, and ambience controls remain usable.
steps: Go to Themes and choose Star Wars
Inspect the page heading, body copy, navigation, and Star Wars audio settings
Toggle Star Wars sound effects off and on
Toggle ambience off and on and adjust the ambience slider
Confirm the Voices control is visible and the sound-library status is shown
expected: Star Wars remains active, display headings use the themed lettering while body and control text stay readable, soundtrack/SFX/ambience/voice controls remain usable, and the sound-library status is visible.
